description: Search the CodeTrendy directory of new startups, SaaS and AI tools. Read-only, no API key.

io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Public, read-only MCP server for CodeTrendy, a curated discovery directory of newly launched startups, SaaS products and AI tools. Seven read-only tools: search_listings (keyword search with optional category and pricing filters), get_listing (full listing profile by slug), find_alternatives (alternatives to a named product), browse_category, list_categories, get_trending and get_site_of_the_day. No API key, no account, no write access. Docs: https://codetrendy.com/mcp
